what: Plan adds orchestrator-inline stderr that prints found count but does not reset count per manifest row
scenario_or_breakage: The loop already sets count for external-prompt rows; if a later orchestrator-inline row fails because the file is missing or the case arm is skipped, stderr can report a stale found value from the previous row
suggested_fix: Mention initializing count=0 at the start of each loop iteration (or at the top of the orchestrator-inline arm) before grep -Ec
